title: BPSC Auditor Pre OMR Sheet 2026
postName: Auditor Preliminary Examination – OMR Response Sheet
vacancyDetails: Answer key related update for Auditor Preliminary Examination – OMR Response Sheet
selectionProcess: Written / CBT → Answer Key / Objections → Result
documentsRequired: Registration number / roll number; admit card for reference
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bpsc.bih.nic.in
2. Open Answer Key / Response Sheet section
3. Download BPSC Auditor Pre OMR Sheet 2026
4. Match answers with your response sheet
5. Raise objections within the official window if allowed
shortDescription: BPSC Auditor Pre OMR Sheet 2026 available. Download response sheet from bpsc.bih.nic.in.
content:
Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the Auditor Preliminary OMR Sheet / Response Sheet 2026.

Candidates can download their OMR responses from the official portal, compare with the answer key and raise objections if the window is open.
